```{r raw data}


#### load IP data and metadata
#IP_metadata <- xx
seqIP <- read.table(here::here("data-raw/IP_proteinGroups.txt"),
                    header = TRUE,
                    sep = "\t",
                    na.strings = c("NaN"),
                    check.names = FALSE)

## wrangling
seqIP_intensity <- seqIP %>%
    dplyr::select(contains("Intensity"), `Gene names`, `Protein IDs`) %>%
    dplyr::select(-contains("LFQ"))
seqIP_intensity <- seqIP_intensity %>%
    mutate(`Gene names` = ifelse(is.na(`Gene names`) | `Gene names` == "", `Protein IDs`, `Gene names`))

row.names(seqIP_intensity) <- seqIP_intensity$`Gene names`
seqIP_intensity <- seqIP_intensity %>%
    dplyr::select(-`Gene names`, -`Protein IDs`, -`Intensity`)
seqIP_intensity <- seqIP_intensity %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")  

column_mapping <- set_names(IP_metadata$Sample, IP_metadata$Mqpeptides)
new_colnames <- colnames(seqIP_intensity)[-1]  
matched_indices <- match(new_colnames, IP_metadata$Mqpeptides)
new_colnames[!is.na(matched_indices)] <- IP_metadata$Sample[matched_indices[!is.na(matched_indices)]]
colnames(seqIP_intensity)[-1] <- new_colnames 

merged_data <- seqIP_intensity %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Gene, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Intensity") %>%  # Keep "Gene" in long format
    left_join(IP_metadata, by = "Sample") %>%
    mutate(Intensity = ifelse(Intensity == 0, NA, Intensity))  # Replace 0 with NA


```


```{r dynamic range plots}

dynamic_range <- merged_data %>%
    group_by(Gene, Bait) %>%
    summarise(median_Intensity = median(Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(RankAbundance = rank(-median_Intensity),
           Log10MedianIntensity = log10(median_Intensity))

label_genes <- c("PRKAA1", "PRKAA2", "PRKAB1", "PRKAB2", "PRKAG1", "PRKAG2", "PRKAG3")
labels <- dynamic_range %>%
    filter(Gene %in% label_genes)

dynamic_range_a1 <- dynamic_range %>% filter(Bait == "a1")
dynamic_range_a2 <- dynamic_range %>% filter(Bait == "a2")

ggplot(dynamic_range_a1, aes(x = RankAbundance, y = Log10MedianIntensity)) +
    geom_point(color = "violet", alpha = 0.3, shape = 21) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels %>% filter(Bait == "a1"), aes(label = Gene), size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Dynamic Range - A1")

ggplot(dynamic_range_a2, aes(x = RankAbundance, y = Log10MedianIntensity)) +
    geom_point(color = "purple3", alpha = 0.3, shape = 21) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels %>% filter(Bait == "a2"), aes(label = Gene), size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "Dynamic Range - A2")


```

```{r filter}

# 50% valid intensity values in at least one Bait group
filter50p <- merged_data %>%
    group_by(Gene, Bait) %>%
    summarise(valid_proportion = mean(!is.na(log2_Intensity)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(valid_proportion >= 0.50) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Bait)  

filtered_data <- merged_data %>%
    inner_join(filter50p, by = c("Gene", "Bait"))

#remaining unique proteins
filtered_protein_count <- filtered_data %>%
    distinct(Gene) %>%
    nrow()
print(filtered_protein_count) 
# 961




seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix <- filtered_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Sample, log2_Intensity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2_Intensity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
```

```{r PCA}

pca_input <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Sample, log2_Intensity, Bait, Timepoint) %>%  
    group_by(Gene, Sample) %>%
    summarise(log2_Intensity = mean(log2_Intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%  
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2_Intensity) %>%  
    column_to_rownames("Gene")  

metadata_pca <- merged_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Bait, Timepoint) %>%
    distinct()  

pca_input <- pca_input[complete.cases(pca_input), ]

# Transpose
pca_transposed <- as.data.frame(t(pca_input))

pca_object <- prcomp(pca_transposed, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE)

data_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_object$x) %>%
    dplyr::select(PC1, PC2) 

data_pca$Sample <- rownames(data_pca)

data_pca <- data_pca %>%
    inner_join(metadata_pca, by = "Sample")  


pca_ID <- ggplot(
    data_pca,
    aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = PC2,
        label = Sample,
        color = Bait, 
        shape = Timepoint  
    )
) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    theme_light() +
    ggtitle("PCA - log2 Intensity Filtered") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Sample), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, color = "black")


plotly::ggplotly(pca_ID)

# variance explained by each PC
fviz_eig(pca_object, addlabels = TRUE) +
    theme_light() +
    ggtitle("Eigenvalues")
# 58%, 11.6%

```



```{r scale pull-down to bait proteins}


################################## FIGURE 6D ##############################

# Normalize a1 dataset to PRKAA1
normalized_a1 <- merged_data %>%
  filter(Bait == "a1", Gene %in% selected_genes) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(
    bait_expression = log2_Intensity[Gene == "PRKAA1"],
    log2_scaled = log2_Intensity - bait_expression
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

normalized_a1 <- normalized_a1 %>%
  mutate(
    y_value = if_else(Gene == "PRKAA1", log2_Intensity, log2_scaled),
    scale_type = if_else(Gene == "PRKAA1", "Raw (unscaled)", "Scaled to PRKAA1")
  )

# normalize pull-downs for a2
normalized_a2 <- merged_data %>%
  filter(Bait == "a2", Gene %in% selected_genes) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(
    bait_expression = log2_Intensity[Gene == "PRKAA2"],
    log2_scaled = log2_Intensity - bait_expression
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    y_value = if_else(Gene == "PRKAA2", log2_Intensity, log2_scaled),
    scale_type = if_else(Gene == "PRKAA2", "Raw (unscaled)", "Scaled to PRKAA2")
  )



plot_boxplot_mixed <- function(data, title) {
  data$Timepoint <- factor(data$Timepoint, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = y_value, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01, size = 0.2, fatten = 0.8, color = "black", width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Group), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Participant, color = Group), size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Expression (log2 scaled or raw)",
      subtitle = "Bait protein shown in raw values; others normalized to bait"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
      text = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5)
    )
}



plot_a1 <-plot_boxplot_mixed(normalized_a1, "a1: Bait raw, others normalized")
plot_a2 <- plot_boxplot_mixed(normalized_a2, "a2: Bait raw, others normalized")

p <- plot_a1 | plot_a2
```

```{r LIMMA}

# wide format matrix for LIMMA
seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix <- filtered_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Sample, log2_Intensity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2_Intensity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()


IP_metadata <- IP_metadata %>% 
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, colnames(seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix)))


IP_metadata$Combined <- paste(IP_metadata$Bait, IP_metadata$Group, IP_metadata$Timepoint, sep = "_")

Bait <- factor(IP_metadata$Bait, levels=c("a1", "a2"))
Group <- factor(IP_metadata$Group, levels=c("Lean","Obese","T2D"))
Training <- factor(IP_metadata$Timepoint, levels=c("Pre", "Post"))
Combined <- factor(IP_metadata$Combined, levels = c("a1_Lean_Pre", "a2_Lean_Pre", "a1_Lean_Post", "a2_Lean_Post", "a1_Obese_Pre", "a2_Obese_Pre", "a1_Obese_Post", "a2_Obese_Post", "a1_T2D_Pre", "a2_T2D_Pre", "a1_T2D_Post", "a2_T2D_Post"))



################ split data by bait

a1_data <- filtered_data %>% filter(Bait == "a1")
a2_data <- filtered_data %>% filter(Bait == "a2")

expr_a1 <- a1_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Sample, log2_Intensity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2_Intensity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

expr_a2 <- a2_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Sample, log2_Intensity) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = log2_Intensity) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta_a1 <- IP_metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_a1)) %>% arrange(match(Sample, colnames(expr_a1)))
meta_a2 <- IP_metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_a2)) %>% arrange(match(Sample, colnames(expr_a2)))

design_a1 <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Group + Timepoint, data = meta_a1)
design_a2 <- model.matrix(~ 0+  Group + Timepoint, data = meta_a2)

corfit_a1 <- duplicateCorrelation(expr_a1, design_a1, block = meta_a1$Participant)
corfit_a2 <- duplicateCorrelation(expr_a2, design_a2, block = meta_a2$Participant)

fit_a1 <- lmFit(expr_a1, design_a1, block = meta_a1$Participant, correlation = corfit_a1$consensus)
fit_a2 <- lmFit(expr_a2, design_a2, block = meta_a2$Participant, correlation = corfit_a2$consensus)

fit2_a1 <- eBayes(fit_a1)
fit2_a2 <- eBayes(fit_a2)

table_MainEffect_Training_a1 <- topTable(fit2_a1, coef = 4, number = Inf, adjust = "fdr")
table_MainEffect_Training_a1$Protein <- rownames(table_MainEffect_Training_a1)
table_MainEffect_Training_a2 <- topTable(fit2_a2, coef = "TimepointPre", number = Inf, adjust = "fdr")
table_MainEffect_Training_a2$Protein <- rownames(table_MainEffect_Training_a2)



##################### specific contrasts

design_combined <- model.matrix(~ 0 + Combined)
corfit__combined <- duplicateCorrelation(seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix, design_combined, block=IP_metadata$Participant)
corfit__combined$consensus
# 0.1580649
fit_combined <- lmFit(seqIP_log2_filter_widematrix, design_combined, block=IP_metadata$Participant, correlation=corfit__combined$consensus)

cm_all <- makeContrasts(

  # --- GROUP DIFFERENCES ---

  # Pre
  Lean_vs_T2D_a1_Pre = Combineda1_Lean_Pre - Combineda1_T2D_Pre,
  Lean_vs_T2D_a2_Pre = Combineda2_Lean_Pre - Combineda2_T2D_Pre,
  Obese_vs_T2D_a1_Pre = Combineda1_Obese_Pre - Combineda1_T2D_Pre,
  Obese_vs_T2D_a2_Pre = Combineda2_Obese_Pre - Combineda2_T2D_Pre,
  Lean_vs_Obese_a1_Pre = Combineda1_Lean_Pre - Combineda1_Obese_Pre,
  Lean_vs_Obese_a2_Pre = Combineda2_Lean_Pre - Combineda2_Obese_Pre,

  # Post
  Lean_vs_T2D_a1_Post = Combineda1_Lean_Post - Combineda1_T2D_Post,
  Lean_vs_T2D_a2_Post = Combineda2_Lean_Post - Combineda2_T2D_Post,
  Obese_vs_T2D_a1_Post = Combineda1_Obese_Post - Combineda1_T2D_Post,
  Obese_vs_T2D_a2_Post = Combineda2_Obese_Post - Combineda2_T2D_Post,
  Lean_vs_Obese_a1_Post = Combineda1_Lean_Post - Combineda1_Obese_Post,
  Lean_vs_Obese_a2_Post = Combineda2_Lean_Post - Combineda2_Obese_Post,

  # --- TRAINING EFFECTS (Post vs Pre within group + bait) ---

  Lean_training_a1 = Combineda1_Lean_Post - Combineda1_Lean_Pre,
  Lean_training_a2 = Combineda2_Lean_Post - Combineda2_Lean_Pre,
  Obese_training_a1 = Combineda1_Obese_Post - Combineda1_Obese_Pre,
  Obese_training_a2 = Combineda2_Obese_Post - Combineda2_Obese_Pre,
  T2D_training_a1 = Combineda1_T2D_Post - Combineda1_T2D_Pre,
  T2D_training_a2 = Combineda2_T2D_Post - Combineda2_T2D_Pre,

  # --- BAIT EFFECTS (a2 - a1) within each group and timepoint ---

  # Pre
  Lean_bait_Pre = Combineda2_Lean_Pre - Combineda1_Lean_Pre,
  Obese_bait_Pre = Combineda2_Obese_Pre - Combineda1_Obese_Pre,
  T2D_bait_Pre = Combineda2_T2D_Pre - Combineda1_T2D_Pre,

  # Post
  Lean_bait_Post = Combineda2_Lean_Post - Combineda1_Lean_Post,
  Obese_bait_Post = Combineda2_Obese_Post - Combineda1_Obese_Post,
  T2D_bait_Post = Combineda2_T2D_Post - Combineda1_T2D_Post,

  levels = design_combined
)


fit2_combined <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit_combined, cm_all))

comparisons <- colnames(cm_all)

extract_and_store_full_table <- function(fit, comparison_name, p_value_threshold = 0.05) {
    full_table <- limma::topTable(fit,
                                  coef = comparison_name,
                                  adjust = "BH",
                                  number = Inf)
    full_table$Protein <- rownames(full_table)
    significant_table <- full_table[full_table$adj.P.Val < p_value_threshold, ]
    significant_table <- na.omit(significant_table)
    cat("Comparison:", comparison_name, " - Number of significant hits:", nrow(significant_table), "\n")
    assign(paste0(comparison_name), full_table, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    return(nrow(significant_table))
}

for (comparison in comparisons) {
  extract_and_store_full_table(fit2_combined, comparison)
}
```

```{r PostIP supernatant data}
table_MainEffect_Training_postIP$Protein <- rownames(table_MainEffect_Training_postIP)

selected_genes <- c("PRKAA1", "PRKAA2", "PRKAB1", "PRKAB2", "PRKAG1", "PRKAG2", "PRKAG3")

boxplot_data_s <- merged_data %>%
    filter(Gene %in% selected_genes)



plot_boxplot2 <- function(data, title) {
  data$Timepoint <- factor(data$Timepoint, levels = c("Pre", "Post"))
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2_Intensity, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.01, size = 0.2, fatten = 0.8, color = "black", width = 0.6) +

    geom_point(aes(color = Group), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +

    geom_line(aes(group = Participant, color = Group), size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "Log2 Expression") +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
    
    #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(15, 27)) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
      text = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
    )
}

plot_s <- plot_boxplot2(boxplot_data_s, "s")
plot_s
```
